doctrine.admission_rule: A wave record must point to official public artifacts, project onto existing design pylons and registry gaps, name a bounded first transaction, and preserve a public substitution route.
doctrine.control_question: Which new public mechanism closes scale, venue, or causal custody while remaining replaceable behind the existing workload, pylon, and receipt authority?
doctrine.promotion_rule: A wave record may enter the main commodity registry only after source identity, license, adapter, reference fixture, receipt schema, and substitute coverage are qualified.
doctrine.statement: Second-wave intake expands the two mapped-open pylons and the causal-custody dependencies beneath them without promoting any external actor into architecture authority.
